# Train with Ehsan

> Self-defense, Muay Thai and Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu training in Istanbul, Türkiye, taught by Ehsan Dibazar (MSc in Sport Science) under the "Martial Intelligence" method — decision-making under pressure, not just technique. Courses are for complete beginners, women and men, in person in Istanbul or through the training app.

## Pages

- [Home](https://trainwithehsan.com/): overview of courses and the Martial Intelligence method
- [About](https://trainwithehsan.com/about): Ehsan Dibazar's background, certificates and experience
- [Blog](https://trainwithehsan.com/blog): articles on self-defense, Muay Thai and Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu
- [Contact](https://trainwithehsan.com/contact): contact details and message form
- [FAQ](https://trainwithehsan.com/faq): frequently asked questions

Turkish versions of every page are available under the `/tr` prefix (e.g. `https://trainwithehsan.com/tr/blog`).
